question.body:
A particle moves along the $x$-axis with velocity given by $v(t)= frac(10 sin lr((0.4 t^(2))),t^(2)- t + 3)$ for time $0 <= t <= 3.5$. The particle is at position $x = - 5$ at time $t = 0$.

(a) Find the acceleration of the particle at time $t = 3$.

(b) Find the position of the particle at time $t = 3$.

(c) Evaluate $integral_(0)^(3.5) v(t) d t$, and evaluate $integral_(0)^(3.5)| v(t)| d t$. Interpret the meaning of each integral in the context of the problem.

(d) A second particle moves along the $x$-axis with position given by $x_(2)(t)= t^(2)- t$ for $0 <= t <= 3.5$. At what time $t$ are the two particles moving with the same velocity?
